title: State coordinator briefing
description: A briefing from a crisis center to the state 988 coordinator during a surge: situation, service measures against targets, staffing, backup status, asks of the state and the next briefing time. All numbers come from the center's own report and say so. Everything is fictional and marked as an exercise product; a real helpline number never appears without the EXERCISE marking, and no real person or address is used.

subtitle.description: Line under the organization: unit, site, period

examples: Crisis Center Director, Harbor County Crisis Services

situation.description: Where the center stands, in three sentences, with numbers and time
examples: Contacts are 1.9 times last week. Texts wait about 11 minutes. Backup for texts has been active since 19:42.

measures.description: Measure, value, target and its source

target.description: Target and where it comes from

examples: 14 counselors on the floor against 19 needed. Call-in list worked; overnight is short by 3.

asks.description: What the center needs from the state
examples: Confirm a second backup center for texts overnight.
Approve overtime above the contract cap for 72 hours.
Issue a joint public message on wait times.
